notes.subject: ⟨i⟩
notes.rationale: אאלפך kɔnɔ nɔnabila kunafoni in bɛ Bamanankan kɔnɔ; Heburukan bɛ nɔnabila min bila a kɔnɔ kunafoni ye

notes.subject: bɛna
notes.rationale: Yɛlɛma taamasiyɛn min bɛ Bamanankan kɔnɔ (cohortative ni wajibiya), Heburukan ka wale-daɲɛ yɛrɛ b'a fɔ o cogo la; a farala a kan walasa k'a jira ko ne bɛna a kɛ

notes.subject: Elihu ka Job wele
notes.rationale: Weleli-cogo ɲɛnamaw: «mɛn ne ma», «zɔgɔti» — kɔlɔsilidasira min bɛ kuma kalanbaga ma

notes.subject: Job
notes.rationale: Elihu b'a kuma Job ma k'a ɲɛ sin o de kan

translation: Ni ayi, i mɛn ne ma; i zɔgɔti, ani ne bɛna hakili kalan ⟨i⟩ ye.
